content.value: Horse and wolf armour use fixed base stats equivalent to strong player sets. They cannot receive random, targeted, or Artificial runes. Every modifier uses the animal body slot, so holding the item or riding the animal never grants its statistics to the player.

Leather Horse Armour: +60 evasion and +15% base movement speed.
Golden Horse Armour: +55 armour and +35 Energy Shield. It has no extra item rarity.
Iron Horse Armour: +120 armour and +20% knockback resistance.
Diamond Horse Armour: +300 armour, +10 maximum health, and +0.75 health regeneration per second.
Wolf Armour: +120 armour and +20% knockback resistance, matching iron.

The equipped animal receives the matching armour, evasion, Energy Shield, life regeneration, health, speed, and knockback values through its BODY equipment slot. Energy Shield follows normal recharge and damage rules; Diamond regeneration heals the wearer continuously.

Diamond animal armour is supposed to regenerate the equipped animal. If an unarmoured animal regenerates, inspect its traits, status effects, or another mod; this armour does not apply from inventory, hand, or rider state.
